names.zh: 科特迪吉早期层位与设防组合
names.en: Kot Diji Early Harappan levels and fortification assemblage

summary.zh: Khan 1965 报告区分的科特迪吉（早期）层位、陶器与泥砖/石砌设防；上层为成熟哈拉帕。早期「被征服/大火」叙事属历史诠释，不作事实定论。
summary.en: Kot Dijian (Early) levels, pottery, and mud-brick/stone fortification as distinguished in Khan 1965; Mature Harappan above. Early “conquest/conflagration” narratives are historical interpretation, not fact verdicts here.
